title: Why Your Phone Dies So Fast
hook: Never leave background app refresh on.

script.narration: Never leave background app refresh on.
First, letting dozens of apps update silently drains your battery all day long.
Second, keeping your screen brightness at maximum constantly overworks the display.
Third, leaving location services set to always track every app wastes massive power. Turn these off now.
Like if this helped, follow for tech tips. Did your battery last longer? Comment yes or no to never leave background app refresh on.

description: Discover three common mistakes that drain your phone battery instantly and how to fix them in seconds. Stop letting hidden settings waste your charge every single day. Follow for more fast technology tips.
why_it_will_work: Taps into highly searched tech problems regarding battery life using a proven 3-mistakes structure that hooks viewers immediately.
